meta.title: PR Detail View: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as the user without the Buyer role and verify whether PR Detail View is refused or absent.
Sign in as a Buyer on the same tenant and verify that PR Detail View is available.
Verify the PR detail view shows all line items, their statuses, and the requisitioner.
Verify or select the tenant's Growth or Enterprise plan.
Compare the two users' role-specific access in separate sessions.

plan.title: PR Detail View Buyer Role Access

steps.note: Reaches the closest available Purchase Requisitions screen; the catalog has no step for opening a PR detail view.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer and Buyer users on the same Growth-or-higher tenant, open the same PR Detail View, and verify the non-Buyer is refused or lacks the action while the Buyer can view all line items, statuses, and the requisitioner

steps.note: The required role-specific sessions, PR detail view, and oracle comparison are not expressible by catalog steps.
Confirms the closest Purchase Requisitions screen remains present after the tester interaction; it does not assert PR Detail View access.
